from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """A single company's financial data for ROA calculation from one filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    net_income_amount: float | None = Field(description="Consolidated net income amount as reported")
    net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of net income: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    total_assets_amount: float | None = Field(description="Total assets amount as reported")
    total_assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of total assets: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date for this filing (e.g. '2025-03')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the financial figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_metrics: list[CompanyFinancialMetric]
